_meta.name: Sunheart Brain workspace schema
_meta.description: Canonical spec for the 7 Sunheart Brain databases. Used by build_schema.py to create/verify the AppFlowy workspace state at brain.sunheart.com.

databases.name: 01 · Notes
databases.purpose: Raw firehose — every atom of content ingested from any source (Bear, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, manual). One row per note. Full-text searchable.

fields.name: Title
fields.note: First 80 chars of content if no explicit title

fields.name: Content
fields.note: Full body (markdown). Can be very long; truncated to 32 KB.

fields.name: Source ID
fields.note: Stable external id: Bear note uuid, ChatGPT conversation id+msg idx, Claude msg id, Cursor chat uuid.

fields.name: Source URL
fields.note: Deep link back to original (bear://, chat.openai.com/c/…, claude.ai/chat/…)

fields.name: Original Created At
fields.note: When the note/message was originally written

fields.name: Embedding Hash
fields.note: SHA1 of the text that was embedded. Lets us reembed on change.

fields.name: Sensitivity
fields.note: Public = any AI can read. Personal = local embeddings only, blocked from GPT Connector. Private = should have been filtered at ingest; if present, never returned via search.

fields.name: PII Flags
fields.note: Set by ingest PII scrubber or manually. Any flagged row is force-tiered ≥ 🟡.

databases.name: 02 · Concepts
databases.purpose: Canonical deduped layer. Many Notes → one Concept. This is the semantic map of your brain.

fields.name: Aliases
fields.note: Other phrasings that mean the same thing, newline-separated

fields.name: Description
fields.note: AI-synthesized summary of what this concept is

fields.name: Note Count
fields.note: Maintained by brain-index on dedup

fields.name: Embedding Centroid
fields.note: Reference id into brain-index pgvector table

databases.name: 03 · Conversations
databases.purpose: AI chat threads. A conversation has many notes (one per useful message). Lets you re-enter a thread with full context.

fields.name: External ID
fields.note: Provider's conversation id

fields.name: Summary
fields.note: AI-generated 2-3 sentence summary of what this thread was about

databases.name: 04 · Sources
databases.purpose: Provenance registry. One row per data source (Bear app instance, ChatGPT export file, etc.).

fields.name: Location
fields.note: SQLite path, export zip path, directory, URL, etc.

fields.name: Enabled
fields.note: If unchecked, brain-ingest skips this source

databases.name: 05 · Tags
databases.purpose: Controlled tag vocabulary. AI proposes new tags during ingest; you curate weekly.

databases.name: 06 · Audit
databases.purpose: Every MCP/index call logged. Review weekly to spot anomalies (unexpected agents, unusual query patterns, scope violations).

fields.name: Agent
fields.note: Which token (agent name from tokens.json)

fields.name: Tool
fields.note: brain_search_semantic | brain_add_note | /index/search | …

fields.name: Query Prefix
fields.note: First 60 chars of the query or note title

fields.name: Blocked?
fields.note: True if the request was blocked by scope

databases.name: 07 · Curator Queue
databases.purpose: Proposals from the brain-curator (AI-to-AI optimizer). High-confidence safe ops auto-apply and land here as ✅ Applied for audit. Everything else sits as 🟡 Proposed until you flip Status to ✅ Approved — the next curator run executes it.

fields.name: Proposal
fields.note: One-line summary of the proposed change

fields.name: AI Reasoning
fields.note: Why the AI thinks this change is correct; includes model name + prompt hash

fields.name: Diff
fields.note: JSON payload describing the exact change (idempotent replay)

fields.name: Decided By
fields.note: user email, or 'auto' for auto-applied high-confidence ops

fields.name: Run ID
fields.note: Groups all proposals from one curator run

sources.Name: Bear (local macOS)
sources.Notes: Primary note-taking app on the Mac

sources.Name: ChatGPT Export
sources.Notes: From Settings → Data Controls → Export data

sources.Name: Cursor Agent Transcripts
sources.Notes: Local Cursor chat history, already structured
